paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between context consistency and context inconsistency under the prefix-constrained decoding Setting. The x-aixs denotes the number of tokens for the gold prefix.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the comparison of BLEU scores between two settings, Consistency: wait-1 and Inconsistency: wait-9, under the prefix-constrained decoding setting. The x-axis, labeled "the length of gold prefix," has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 20, and tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," also has a linear scale with values from 23 to 29 and tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The Consistency: wait-1 line is blue with circle markers and a dashed line style, starting at approximately 23.5 BLEU at a gold prefix length of 0, fluctuating to around 24.5 BLEU at a length of 3, then steadily increasing to about 28.5 BLEU at a length of 20. The Inconsistency: wait-9 line is orange with square markers and a solid line style, starting at around 25.5 BLEU at a gold prefix length of 0, peaking at approximately 26.5 BLEU at lengths of 2 and 6, then gradually declining to about 25.5 BLEU at a length of 20, before rising to 26 BLEU.
